question: A, B and C together can complete a certain work in 40 days. B and C together can complete the same work in 72 days. B is 50% more efficient than A. A, B and C work together for 16 days. B alone will complete the remaining work in:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work = LCM(40, 72) = 360 units.

Efficiency (A+B+C) = 9, Efficiency (B+C) = 5.

Efficiency A = 9 − 5 = 4; Efficiency B = 1.5 × 4 = 6.

Remaining work after 16 days = 360 − (16 × 9) = 360 − 144 = 216 units.

Time taken by B = 216 ÷ 6 = 36 days.

**∴ Answer = 36 days**
